# FLX-3125: a date or timestamp column publishes one value the engine cannot yet write on every row

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A DATE column whose one published value is 9999-12-30 or 9999-12-31, or a TIMESTAMP column whose one published value is within 2 milliseconds of the last instant the calendar holds, is drawn as exactly that value, and the engine cannot yet spell the second grid step past it, which closes the bin the value is drawn from. `fluxsim init` leaves the table of such a column out of the bundle, and refuses with this code only when something it writes needs that table: a relationship of a table it writes targets it, or a history file names it. The message names the table and the column. Write the column's open end as NULL, or make a DATE column a TIMESTAMP, or write a TIMESTAMP's end as an earlier instant. Nothing was written.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3125
```
